subject: Projection predictive variable selection using Stan+R

messages.author: a236d3d356ca53fd
messages.subject: Projection predictive variable selection using Stan+R
parts:
We (with Juho Piironen) have published technical note and code for doing sparse variable selection with Stan. The approach is based on the sparsity prompting priors, predictive utilities and the projection predictive approach for the actual variable selection.

The article with a larger set of experiments (but no Stan)
  Comparison of Bayesian predictive methods for model selection
  http://arxiv.org/abs/1503.08650

The supplement describing the model and experiments with Stan
  Projection predictive variable selection using Stan+R
  http://arxiv.org/abs/1508.02502

The Stan+R code
 https://github.com/jtpi/rstan-varsel

Aki

messages.subject: Re: Projection predictive variable selection using Stan+R
parts:
Sure. We don't have ready made implementation, but you could modify the Stan model so that grouped variables have common prior parameters and the projection equations can be modified to take this into account, too.

Aki
